No. 2141/17 – WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2019
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7

My Reference No.: KDS/TUM/04/01/01/07. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land to be Acquired:

An allotment of land called 'Gallenawaththa' in extent of 0.0202 Hectare depicted as Lot No. 01 in the PVP No. KA 6914 prepared by Surveyor General of Kandy which situated in the Village called BanAnga in the Grama Niladhari Division of 364-Gallenawaththa within the Thumpane, Galagedara Divisional Secretariat Division in the District of Kandy in the Central Province and morefully described as follows:
1. Lot No. 1 Name of the land: Gallenawaththa; Extent of the Land: 0.0202 Hectare.
Boundaries North: Lot No. 56 of P.P. KA 4223; East: Lot No. 56 of P. P. KA 4223; South: Lot No. 56 of P. P. KA 4223
and F. V. P. 134 Village Boundary; West: F. V. P. 134 Village boundary.
Name and Addresss of the Claimant: W. G. Ramyalatha, No. 31, Gallenawaththa, Kumburegama, Kandy.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land is hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Thumpane Divisional Secretariat, on the 04th day of December 2019, at 09.00 a. m.

Further are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 27th day of November 2019 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
gfg S. M. C. GUNARATHNA, Divisional Secretary, Thumpane.
At Divisional Secretariat, Thumpane, On the 09th day of September, 2019.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
My Reference No.: Ambako/3/5/A/157. Land Ministry Reference No.: 4-3/2/2013/FR/83.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the land or Servitude to be Acquired:

The land called Binoya Estate of total extent about 28.2916 Hectares, shown lots Nos. 01, 02 in Block No.04 Sheet No. 01 of C. M. No. 330252 dated 21.08.2019 prepared by the Surveyor General,situated in the Village of Ruwanpura in the 320-G Ruwanpura Grama Niladhari Division of the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ambagamuwa Koralaya, in the District of Nuwara-Eliya.
01. Lot No. 01 - Total extent of about 28.0345 Hectares
North: Block 5; East: Block 5, Lot No. 2 and Block 1; South: Block 1 and Lot No. 3; West: Block 5.
02. Lot No. 02 - Total extent of about 0.2571 Hectare
North: Lot No. 1; East: Block 1; South: Block 1 and Lot No. 1; West: Lot No. 1.
Claimant's Name and Address: Land Reform Commission, No. 475, Kaduwela Road, Baththaramulla.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Ambagamuwa Koralaya on the 23rd Day of October 2019 at 01.00 p. m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 09th day of October 2019, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude. The amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
gfg R. T. P. SUMANASEKARA, Divisional Secretary, Ambagamuwa Koralaya.
